title.narrative: Assist crisis-affected people in Myanmar to meet their food and nutrition needs

description.narrative: The main objective of this WFP project is to support women, men, girls, and boys affected by a crisis, ensuring they receive timely food and/or cash-based transfers that meet their daily nutritional needs. This is intended to lead to the expected impact of improved food security. WFP supports cash transfers to meet the basic monthly food needs of Chin and Kachin states. WFP provides an estimated 38,500 people affected by conflict with a one-month ration of food, including rice, pulses, oil, and salt. The distribution will be coordinated with assistance from UNHCR and UNICEF. Each person from WFP receives a ration comprising 13.5kg of rice, 1.8kg of pulses, 0.9kg of oil, and 0.15kg of salt. The project provides life-saving assistance to 93,500 people, including 32,725 women, 26,180 men, and 34,595 children. An estimated 6,546 people with disabilities are expected to benefit from this project.
